title: SOUL 3.3.2 – Major Platform & “php2shell” Security Vulnerability fix

body_markdown:
#### **SOUL –** **Modern 3.3.2** **on Docker – Major Platform & Security Update!**


###


**Prerequisite for this update is an active SOUL+ contract and a Protonet server with SOUL version stable /xxx. You will see the version after logging into your SOUL on the help page.**


This release introduces a major modernization of the Protonet SOUL platform. The underlying environment has been upgraded from the legacy base to a current supported Ubuntu release running within Docker.


This significantly improves SOUL´s security, portability, maintainability, and hardware compatibility. Replacing the outdated Ubuntu 12.04.1 LTS base represents a significant security improvement. The new environment provides access to a modern, actively maintained software stack with ongoing security updates and vulnerability fixes. The Dockerized architecture additionally provides better isolation and a more controlled, reproducible runtime environment.


**Bug Fix – php2shell Security Vulnerabilities:**


Fixed two critical PHP memory-handling vulnerabilities ( **CVE-2026-109618** and **CVE-2026-109619** ), collectively known as **“php2shell”.** These could allow an attacker to execute code on the server through specially crafted web requests without logging in, potentially compromising data. We strongly recommend updating to this release!


You can find more info regarding this vulnerability here:
[https://thephp.foundation/blog/2026/10/21/todays-php-security-release-and-how-were-strengthening-php-security/](https://thephp.foundation/blog/2026/10/21/todays-php-security-release-and-how-were-strengthening-php-security/)


**Dockerized Platform:**


- Protonet SOUL is now fully containerized, allowing it to run in a standard Docker environment independently of the host operating system.


**Key benefits include:**


- Hardware independence — SOUL can run on virtually any hardware capable of running Docker.
- Simplified deployment — A consistent, self-contained software environment.
- Improved portability — Easier migration between different hardware and infrastructure.
- Future-proof architecture — A modern foundation for continued development and updates.
- Security Improvements


**Summary:**


- This release marks a significant step forward for Protonet SOUL, moving it from a legacy, hardware-dependent platform to a modern, secure, portable, and containerized architecture.


**Upgrade Procedure:**


- This release introduces a major infrastructure change to the Protonet Box and must be performed with the assistance of Protonet Support. After this migration, you will be able to install subsequent updates yourself through SOUL under **Settings → Update as usual** .


**Before proceeding, please:**


- Create a backup of your data on an external hard drive.
- Contact Protonet Support, we will then provide you with further instructions.


---


**When was the last time you created a backup copy of your Protonet-SOUL?**


Find out how easy it is to back up your data[here](https://support.protonet.info/en/faq/cat-faq/faq/#how-do-i-create-a-backup-of-my-protonet-server) .


Before contacting support please refer to our[SUPPORT PROCESS](https://support.protonet.info/en/faq/support-process/) FAQ.
